newsitem.title: FRANCE: Juppe says 3 pct growth needed to fix unemployment.
newsitem.headline: Juppe says 3 pct growth needed to fix unemployment.

text.p: Prime Minister Alain Juppe said on Wednesday that steady three percent annual growth was necessary to solve the problem of unemployment.

"If we don't recover the trend of steady and durable three percent growth, we won't take care of the unemployment problem," he told the leaders of the small business association CGPME, adding that such a growth rate was possible.
France's unemployment rate stands at a record 12.8 percent.

"Why would France or Europe be the only part of the world that can't attain three percent growth when Asia and China are at seven or nine percent, Latin America is at four or five percent and the United States is above four to five percent?" he said.
"We need to be ambitious in this area. We should refuse the stagnation caused by resignation," he said.
Juppe, who is leading the conservative RPR-UDF campaign for the May 25-June 1 parliamentary election, also took a shot at the platform of the Left, which includes the French Communist Party.
"The proposals the Socialist and Communist parties are putting forward today will not allow France to regain the path of growth," he said.
